name: town-time-schedule-v1
title: Town 时间与 NPC 日程 v1
description: 增加 06:00–24:00 本地时钟、StoredGame v4、四段固定 NPC 日程和活跃位置碰撞；不实现天气、Season、体力、好感或跨地图行走动画。
creator: fable
notes: Implemented GameState/StoredGame v4 minuteOfDay, explicit v3 migration to 06:00, an 8-second/10-minute pause-aware GameSession clock, 24:00 freeze, sleep reset, HUD time, and four-phase schedules for all eight NPCs. Tiled SpawnPoints own every schedule coordinate; one domain resolver feeds WorldScene rendering/click/hit targets, movement/reconcile collision and ShopSystem. Huaqiang is shop-enabled only during day. Schedule validation rejects missing/blocked/overlapping anchors. Life Loop 9/9, Town 5/5, typecheck and client build pass; no weather, Season, energy, friendship, gift, pathfinding, database, image or dependency changes. Deferred follow-ups are now durably tracked in docs/TOWN_ROADMAP.md: schedule walking/avoidance, work/rest days, special schedule priority, friendship/gifts/private-room unlock, calendar/Season/weather, NPC profession services, heart events/festivals, and long-term gameplay systems. Included in the requested consolidated Town-life version; task remains in_progress pending human playtest and later archival.
